title: Support is available
lead: For urgent disability rehabilitation & mental health support, contact the 24×7 national toll-free helpline.
spoken: Support is available. For urgent disability rehabilitation support, call the Kiran national helpline at 1 8 0 0 5 9 9 0 0 1 9 or ALIMCO at 1 8 0 0 1 8 0 5 1 2 9, or dial 1 1 2 for emergency.
kiranDesc: National Mental Health & Disability Rehabilitation Helpline (Govt of India)
